p: all the rites of it: Even in all points as the Lord has instituted it.
by the dead body of a: By touching a corpse, or being at the burial.
offer an offering of the LORD: Or, celebrate the Passover the fourteenth day of the first month.
he shall keep the passover unto: And cannot come where the tabernacle is, when others keep it.
second month at even they shall: So that the unclean and those who are not at home, have a month longer granted to them.
journey: When the Passover is celebrated.
appearance of fire: Like a pillar, read Ex 13:21,22.
LORD the children of Israel journeyed: Who taught them what to do by the cloud.
charge of the LORD: They waited when the Lord would signify either their departure, or their abode by the cloud.
hand of Moses: Under the charge and government of Moses.
